description: Acceptance test manifest. Phase 1 must be fully green before Phase 2 starts.

1.objective: End-to-end thin slice on one OpenRCA incident with ground truth isolated.
1.gate: ALL tests below must pass before Phase 2 begins.

tests.requirement: Load exactly one OpenRCA incident as a typed Incident (no root-cause fields).
tests.acceptance: Incident object constructed; asserts Incident has no attribute exposing root_services/chaos_types.

tests.requirement: Ground truth is loaded only by eval/ and is unreachable from src/deeprca.
tests.acceptance: Static import-graph check finds no src/deeprca -> eval edge; GT loader import from src/deeprca raises.

tests.requirement: Telemetry is exposed only through tools over the Evidence Plane.
tests.acceptance: At least 3 distinct telemetry tools callable (e.g. query_metrics, query_traces, query_topology); each returns Evidence with mandatory provenance.
Ledger contains >=2 Hypothesis objects, each with a falsification_test.

tests.requirement: At least three evidence-gathering tool calls are made.
tests.acceptance: Ledger tool_calls length >= 3, each linked to resulting evidence ids.

tests.requirement: Hypothesis ledger persists and is authoritative (not conversation history).
tests.acceptance: Ledger survives a simulated restart (reload from store); discarding conversation history does not change ledger contents.

tests.requirement: Every Evidence object carries complete provenance.
tests.acceptance: Constructing Evidence without provenance raises; all stored evidence has tool_call_id, source_uri, query, retrieved_at, time_range.

tests.requirement: Every hypothesis tracks supporting and contradicting evidence.
tests.acceptance: Hypothesis has supporting_evidence[] and contradicting_evidence[] fields; reducer updates both.

tests.requirement: Investigator proposes a root cause with a CausalPath.
tests.acceptance: proposed_root_cause present; CausalPath is graph-valid and temporally monotonic.

tests.requirement: In-loop EvaluatorAgent runs independently and emits one decision, with no GT access.
tests.acceptance: Evaluation.decision in {CONTINUE,CONCLUDE,ESCALATE}; runtime scan of evaluator inputs finds no GT value.

tests.requirement: Offline framework compares the frozen result against ground truth.
tests.acceptance: Scorecard produced with localization (exact + top-k), fault-type accuracy, causal-path validity; computed only in eval/.

tests.requirement: No ground-truth value appears anywhere the Investigator can see.
tests.acceptance: Runtime scan of projection + tool results + final ledger for root_services/chaos_types/timing returns zero hits.

1.gate_status: GREEN (20/20 tests pass, incl. live Azure integration 2026-10-03)

3.objective: Knowledge plane: correct root-cause localization via pod-health/silent-service/topology reasoning.
3.gate: Phase-3 accuracy tests must pass (primary incident); aggregate reported by eval/harness.py.
3.gate_status: GREEN (3/3 incidents exact localization + fault-type + valid path + isolation clean, 2026-10-03)

tests.requirement: Investigator localizes a true root-cause service.
tests.acceptance: scorecard localization_hit True on primary incident.

tests.requirement: Investigator names the correct fault type.
Proposed causal path is graph-valid and temporally monotonic.
No GT markers leak with the knowledge plane active.
tests.acceptance: runtime isolation scan returns zero markers.

tests.requirement: Domain knowledge (fault signatures + localization heuristic) injected into projection, GT-free.
tests.acceptance: projection contains knowledge section; src/deeprca/knowledge has no GT access.
